description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController, which provides basic endpoints such as a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints for the application such as greeting, documentation redirect, health status, and info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message indicating the application is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects the client to the Swagger UI page for API documentation, preserving the request's original scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a health check endpoint that returns 'OK', indicating the application is operational.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns information about the application version or identity.
